sessions.model: Not displayed in the VS Code session UI (Copilot Fusion, Standard mode)
sessions.goal: Build and refine the Kadak Chai Co. campaign app, including its frontend, admin experience, AI moderation, and submission documentation.
sessions.kept: The componentized frontend/admin structure, shared client/server validation, AI provider and parser structure, and most of the implemented campaign flow.
sessions.changed: Reworked contact handling so email and phone can both be retained; expanded the English/Hindi UI; corrected provider endpoint and structured-output handling; fixed build issues found during validation; switched API routes to NestJS URI versioning while preserving /api/v1 URLs; moved moderation to a MongoDB-first BullMQ/Redis background flow with pending-review fallback. Follow-up submission work returns only publicId, status, and resultPath from POST; the public lookup returns only publicId/status for rejected entries, while approved results retain their public caption. The approval confirmation uses icon-only copy/open actions, rejection shows only a plain rejection message, and raw stories over 300 Unicode code points are rejected client/server-side (HTTP 400 on the server) rather than truncated. An isolated Redis-unavailable check confirmed the API stored a synthetic entry as pending; live Redis processing and OOM were not tested.
sessions.rejected: No specific implementation was recorded as rejected in the available project conversation.

mistakes_caught.what: The contact form made email and phone mutually exclusive.
mistakes_caught.how: The user reported that entering one erased the other; the form and validation were changed and rechecked.

mistakes_caught.what: A frontend render-time Date.now() call was incompatible with production prerendering.
mistakes_caught.how: The production build exposed the prerender issue; initialization was moved to client-side state.

mistakes_caught.what: An Open Graph route runtime conflicted with cacheComponents, and a dynamic route needed a Suspense boundary.
mistakes_caught.how: The Next.js build surfaced the incompatibilities; the route configuration and boundary were corrected.

mistakes_caught.what: The AI provider setup repeatedly returned bad_output; this indicated response/configuration trouble, not by itself an invalid API key.
mistakes_caught.how: Provider and parser diagnostics plus endpoint inspection led to correcting the Sarvam base URL and structured-output handling. Live key validity was not tested.

mistakes_caught.what: The Docker backend health check probed the authenticated /api/v1/auth/me endpoint and treated HTTP 401 as healthy instead of using the public health endpoint.
mistakes_caught.how: Review found the existing /api/v1/health route; the Compose check was changed to require a successful response from it.

mistakes_caught.what: The initial submission response and rejected-entry lookup exposed story details, and the rejection UI displayed share controls.
mistakes_caught.how: The POST response was reduced to publicId/status/resultPath, rejected lookups now return only publicId/status, and the frontend renders only the rejection message.

mistakes_caught.what: The story textarea silently clipped input at 300 characters, while validation measured text after whitespace normalization.
mistakes_caught.how: Input truncation was removed and both client and server validate the raw Unicode code-point length before normalization; the backend returns HTTP 400 for overlength submissions.
